name: riskmandate-ai
description: Tooling for riskmandate.ai. The SITE has no dependencies — site/ is plain HTML and is deployed unchanged. This file exists only for the maintenance scripts under scripts/site/.

scripts.check: node --test tests/site/*.mjs && node scripts/site/generate.mjs --check && node scripts/site/build-admin.mjs --check && node scripts/site/build-abp-pages.mjs --check && node scripts/site/build-reviewer-pages.mjs --check && node scripts/site/build-uk-support.mjs --check && node scripts/site/build-business-cases.mjs --check && node scripts/site/build-interview-pages.mjs --check && node scripts/packs/build-abp-people-pack.mjs --check && node scripts/site/render-pitch-deck.mjs --check && for d in site/vaults/*/; do s=$(basename "$d"); case "$s" in _template|_app) continue;; esac; node scripts/site/build-abp-vault.mjs "$s" --check || exit 1; done && node scripts/site/sync-modules.mjs --check && node scripts/site/render-lab-pdfs.mjs --check
